-- The review found a stale hello/build.lock and a partial hello/hello.o left by the killed make.
-- Cleaning up: remove both, then list the tree to confirm.
plan = jobs~plan('cleanup')
plan~notify('always')
s = plan~step('remove lock'); s~does(ws, 'remove', .Array~of('hello/build.lock'))
s = plan~step('remove partial object'); s~does(ws, 'remove', .Array~of('hello/hello.o'))
s = plan~step('confirm clean'); s~does(ws, 'list', .Array~of('hello'))
jobs~submit(plan)
return plan
